hooks.text: 角色会自动移动和攻击，但玩家可随时主动释放角色专属技能来加速或越过难关
hooks.excerpt: Your character moves and attacks enemies all on their own, but it can be played actively by making use of character-specific skills and abilities. Playing actively in this way is entirely optional and not mandatory, but can be effective in speeding up your progress or help you overcome challenges.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 七项属性点、可制作升级的装备、召唤物、被动技能与角色专长共同决定构筑
hooks.excerpt: Level up and earn Stat Points which may be distributed within 7 unique Stats, allowing you to create a build. Discover, craft, and upgrade Equipment in order to make yourself stronger. Conjure Summons to aid you in battle. Select Passive Skills to be automatically used in battle , further defining your build. Choose a Character, defining your active abilities and special perks for your playthrough.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 这款放置游戏设有明确终点，并以剧情决策和逐步解锁的新系统推动完整流程
hooks.excerpt: Engage in an expansive storyline, make impactful decisions, and grow stronger through various gameplay features that gradually unlock as you progress. Nomad Idle is an idle game with a defined end and is not designed to be endless.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
